name: ainra-compliance-probe
description: Measure a registrar's accreditation invariants adversarially, from outside, holding nothing the registrar issued: the write door is shut to the probe, the lineage is unmarked, and every verdict comes from a root-dark @ainra/sdk verifier at the strictest policy. Ships with a dishonest registrar to prove the probe can observe failure.
comment: Compliance measured by self-report is compliance until the day it isn't. This kit reads the registrar the way a monitor reads a log — from the outside, with no cooperation required.
